world: Ottilie Varnhagen and her partner Jorrit Aldemere own a townhouse at 14 Fennimore Row, Halden Cross, and rent the upstairs room to a lodger, Perry. In early October 2026 they are deciding whether to accept a kitchen renovation quote from Halvering & Stroud Kitchens (estimator Dunmore Kessane; Revision C of 22 September 2026 replaced a June Revision A), planning a long weekend at Marrowby Point from 22 to 25 October, having Jorrit's car's front brakes done at Tallowick Auto Service, and keeping an October household budget with a kitchen fund, a trip fund and an approved home improvement loan. Their homeowners association issued renovation rules in September 2026. The user of Natively is Ottilie, an ordinary person with no specialised role.

files.title: Halvering & Stroud Kitchens — kitchen renovation quote HS-2291, Revision C

facts.statement: The contractor is Halvering & Stroud Kitchens; the quote was prepared by Dunmore Kessane, estimator.
Quote HS-2291 Revision C was issued on Tuesday 22 September 2026.
Demolition and site protection is priced at $1,900.
Cabinetry (10 base, 8 wall and 1 tall pantry cabinet, soft-close hinges and drawer slides, crown molding, toe kicks, one pull-out waste unit, delivery and installation) is priced at $14,600.

Decorative hardware is not part of the cabinetry price in Revision C: the owners supply their own knobs and pulls, and the contractor fits them at no extra charge if they are on site by the day cabinet installation begins.
doc_needles: supply their own knobs and pulls

facts.statement: Countertops (3 cm quartz, about 46 sq ft, one undermount sink cutout) are priced at $5,300; the owners choose the slab before templating.
The island (6 ft x 3 ft, two base cabinets, quartz top, one outlet, and the flooring patch under the old peninsula) is priced at $4,750.
The island line is optional and may be removed at any time before acceptance; the contract total and every percentage payment then adjust.
doc_needles: removed at any time before acceptance

facts.statement: The backsplash (ceramic subway tile, about 32 sq ft, straight lay) is priced at $2,150.

Plumbing and electrical is priced at $3,400: sink, disposal and dishwasher reconnected in their existing locations, four new countertop outlets, six recessed LED lights on a dimmer, and fitting of the appliances.

The appliance allowance is $6,000 toward a range, range hood, dishwasher and refrigerator; it covers purchase only, overspend is billed at cost with no markup, and anything unspent is credited on the final invoice.
Permit and inspection fees are $650.
The contract total is $38,750, with sales tax on materials included.
Under-cabinet lighting, glass door inserts and interior organizers other than the pull-out waste unit are not included.
Flooring (apart from the island patch), painting, a new sink or faucet, and any homeowner-association notifications or approvals are not included; the owners supply the sink and faucet.
The deposit due on acceptance is 20% of the contract total, which is $7,750.
40% of the contract total, $15,500, is due on delivery of the cabinets to site.
30% of the contract total, $11,625, is due on installation of the countertops.
10% of the contract total, $3,875, is due at the final walkthrough.
Payment is by check or bank transfer; card payments carry a 2.9% processing fee added to the amount charged.

The deposit is refundable less a $500 administration fee if the owners cancel in writing before the cabinets are ordered; the cabinet order is placed within 3 business days of receiving the deposit, after which the deposit is non-refundable.
Work starts on site on Monday 9 November 2026.
Cabinet lead time is approximately 4 weeks from order.
Time on site is an estimated 5 working weeks with no work on 26 and 27 November; target completion is Tuesday 15 December 2026.
Crew hours are 8:00 am to 4:30 pm, Monday to Friday.
To hold the November start, the quote must be accepted and the deposit received by Friday 9 October 2026.
After 9 October the slot is released and the next available start is Monday 11 January 2027.
Prices in Revision C are held until 22 October 2026.
The quote carries no contingency sum; unforeseen conditions are handled by a written change order priced at cost plus 15%, approved in writing before the work begins.
The contractor suggests owners keep roughly 8% of the contract total in reserve, about $3,100.
Workmanship is warranted for two years from the final walkthrough.
Halvering & Stroud carries general liability cover of $2,000,000 and supplies a certificate of insurance on request.
Revision C is signed for Halvering & Stroud by Dunmore Kessane (22 September 2026); the owner acceptance lines are blank, so the owners have not yet accepted it.
The cabinets carry the manufacturer's limited lifetime warranty and the quartz carries the fabricator's 15-year warranty.

files.title: Marrowby Point long weekend plan

facts.statement: The trip runs from Thursday 22 October to Sunday 25 October 2026.
The outbound train leaves Halden Cross at 09:20 and arrives at Marrowby Junction at 11:35 on Thursday; two tickets at $38 each were bought on 12 September on Jorrit's card.
The train home leaves Marrowby Junction at 12:40 on Sunday.
The rental car is with Brindlecar, reservation BRC-774102, in Jorrit's name, a compact automatic.
The car is picked up Thursday at 12:00 noon at the Marrowby Junction station desk and returned on Sunday by 12:00 noon.
The car costs $56 per day for 3 days, taxes included, paid at pick-up ($168 in total).
Brindlecar puts a $250 hold on the card, released when the car is returned.
The hotel is The Corrowick Inn, 3 Lanternhook Lane, Marrowby Point; confirmation CK-58213-M, booked under Aldemere; front desk 555-0187.
The room is $210 per night plus 10% lodging tax, $693 for the 3-night stay; the first night ($210) was paid as a deposit and the balance of $483 is charged at check-in.
Check-in is from 3:00 pm; bags can be left at the desk from noon.
Check-out is 11:00 am; late check-out to 1:00 pm costs $30 if requested the night before.
The hotel can be cancelled free until 6:00 pm on Monday 19 October; after that the first night is kept.
The car park gate code is 4417# and the parking space is B-12 on the lower level.
The code 2290 is for the side door after 10:00 pm, not for the gate.
On Friday 23 October there is a lighthouse boat tour with Pellwick Charters at 9:15 am from Pier 2 (be there by 8:55); two tickets at $48 each are paid in full; booking PW-2217.
On Saturday 24 October there is a guided tidepool walk at 10:30 am at Skerry Cove, $22 each, cash to the guide on the day.
On Saturday at 2:00 pm there is kayak hire from Gullwing Paddle at $35 each; one $35 was paid as a deposit and the other $35 is due on the day.
Dinner on Saturday 24 October is at Saltmarrow Table at 7:45 pm, a table for two under Aldemere, reference SM-3306.
Saltmarrow Table charged a deposit of $40 per person ($80), which comes off the bill; cancelling less than 48 hours ahead forfeits the deposit.
$497 has been paid on the trip so far (train $76, hotel deposit $210, boat tour $96, kayak deposit $35, dinner deposit $80).

Still to pay on the trip are the hotel balance ($483), the car hire ($168), the tidepool walk ($44) and the second kayak ($35), $730 in total, from the trip fund; the dinner bill and food come on top.

files.title: Tallowick Auto Service — repair estimate E-4471

facts.statement: Estimate E-4471 from Tallowick Auto Service is dated Wednesday 30 September 2026, for Jorrit Aldemere's 2019 Sorrel Kestrel; the service advisor is Bexley Thorncastle.
The front brake pads have 2 mm of friction material left against a 3 mm replacement threshold and need replacing now.
The front rotors measure 26.4 mm against a minimum thickness of 25.0 mm (new rotors are 28.0 mm); runout is 0.03 mm against a 0.05 mm limit.
The front rotors are within specification and do not need to be replaced with this set of pads; they should be measured again at the next pad change.
The rear brake pads have 6 mm remaining and need no action; check again in about 10,000 miles.
Brake fluid moisture is 2.4%; a flush is recommended at 3.0% and is not needed today.
Option 1, front pads only, is the recommended option and totals $266.68.
Option 2, front pads and front rotors, totals $521.14 and is not required on the measurements.
Either option takes about an hour and a half; the customer can wait or be phoned when the car is ready.
doc_needles: about an hour and a half

facts.statement: The appointment is Tuesday 6 October 2026 with drop-off at 8:00 am.
The estimate is valid for 14 days from 30 September 2026.
Brake parts and labor are warranted for 12 months or 12,000 miles.
A cabin air filter ($38.00) and wiper blades ($31.00) are optional extras.
Labor is $128.00 per hour; the pad set is $94.00 and a pair of front rotors is $178.00.

must_not_infer: The estimate does not say the rotors are worn or unsafe; it says they are within specification.

files.title: Fennimore Row Homeowners Association — interior renovation rules and 2027 assessments

facts.statement: The notice is dated 1 September 2026, adopted by the Board on 25 August 2026, and applies to work beginning on or after 1 October 2026.

Work that changes a structural or party wall, a shared plumbing stack, the roofline, a window or exterior door opening, or anything visible from outside needs written approval from the Architectural Committee, which answers within 30 days.
Interior work that touches none of those, including replacing a kitchen where fixtures stay on their existing supply and drain locations, does not need Committee approval.
Such interior work needs a Renovation Notification Form filed with the management office at least 14 days before work begins.

The form must be accompanied by the contractor's name, license number and dates, and a certificate of liability insurance showing at least $1,000,000 in general liability cover naming the Association as certificate holder.
Permitted working hours on weekdays are 8:30 am to 5:00 pm.
Saturday work is allowed from 10:00 am to 2:00 pm, quiet work only, with no demolition and no power saws.
doc_needles: No demolition and no power saws

facts.statement: No contractor work is allowed on Sundays or federal holidays.
Owners are fined $75 for each day on which work takes place outside the permitted hours.

A dumpster may stand only on the owner's own driveway for no more than 7 consecutive days and must display a placard from the management office; a $200 refundable damage deposit is taken; it may not be left on the street or in the guest lot; without a placard the fine is $50 per day.
Contractors may use no more than two spaces in the guest lot; additional vehicles park on Harrowgate Road.
Monthly dues rise from $285 to $310 from 1 January 2027.
A special assessment of $600 per unit for the roof reserve is payable in two installments of $300, due 1 February 2027 and 1 August 2027; it is billed separately and not collected by autopay.
The annual meeting is on Thursday 12 November 2026 at 7:00 pm in the clubhouse; proxy forms are due by 5 November.
The property manager is Ysolde Brackenridge at Calloway-Finch Property Management, phone 555-0119.

must_not_infer: The notice does not grant exceptions to working hours or dumpster placement, and the owner cannot grant one on the Association's behalf.
